name: io.github.userdefault13/cron402-mcp
title: cron402
description: Schedule webhook calls and pay per run in USDC on Base via the x402 protocol. Tools: create_cron, topup_cron, get_cron, pause_cron, resume_cron, delete_cron. No accounts or API keys - payments are signed by the agent's own wallet (EIP-3009), settled gasless through the CDP facilitator. Min interval 1 minute, arbitrary cron expressions, retries with auto-pause, execution logs with status codes and latency.

environmentVariables.name: CRON402_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Agent wallet private key (0x…). Fund with USDC on Base mainnet (eip155:8453) or Sepolia (eip155:84532 via CRON402_NETWORK).

environmentVariables.name: CRON402_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: CAIP-2 network id. Default eip155:8453 (Base mainnet); use eip155:84532 for Base Sepolia.

environmentVariables.name: CRON402_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: cron402 API base URL. Defaults to the production Worker.
